info.textSample: Home About Us Locations Membership Press Partnership Contact Us Video Player Media error: Format(s) not supported or source(s) not found Download File: https://www.chubbycattle.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/IMG_8124.mov Search Locations 3 EXPLORE CHUBBY CATTLE INTERNATIONAL Prev Prev ABOUT US Chubby Cattle is redefining the all you can eat dining experience through three distinct concepts: Chubby Cattle BBQ, Chubby Cattle Shabu, and Chubby Cattle Hotpot. With 13 locations across the United States including California, Philadelphia, Las Vegas, Denver, and Duluth, we combine authentic Asian flavors with state of the art dining technology. From ranch sourced premium beef to house made broths and sauces, our menu is crafted to highlight the best ingredients. Whether you are grilling yakiniku, enjoying a light shabu shabu swish, or diving into a rich hotpot, every visit brings something new to explore. Our restaurants feature robot servers, food conveyor belts, and immersive 5D projection dining rooms, making every meal an experience. At Chubby Cattle, tradition meets innovation to create unforgettable moments for every guest.
